title: Vy giật mình (tay ôm má) rồi bình tĩnh lại — nền chroma, lặp được
source: OpenRouter google/veo-3.1-lite (first_frame = last_frame = char.vy.still.neutral-chroma)
quality_note: Đã xem: biểu cảm tốt nhưng giữa clip mắt đổi sang kiểu chấm (lệch model sheet) — dùng được cho cú sốc ngắn.
how_made: node loop-test/src/veo.mjs characters/vy/stills/vy-neutral-chroma-1280x720.png <out> "<prompt>" — prompt: 2D cel-shaded chibi cartoon girl with brown ponytail and yellow bow, coral cardigan. She is suddenly shocked: eyes widen, mouth drops open, both hands fly up to her cheeks and her ponytail jolts, she holds the shocked look for a beat, then calms down and returns to the exact same starting pose and smile. Solid flat chroma green background (#00B140) that stays perfectly uniform, no shadows, no props, no text. Static locked-off camera, no zoom, no pan. Keep the flat 2D cartoon style and thick dark outlines identical to the reference image.
reuse: Tách nền: ffmpeg chromakey=0x01B141:similarity=0.13:blend=0.05 (KHÔNG despill — làm nơ vàng ngả cam); bỏ khung cuối khi nối; xem loop-test/src/loop.sh.
